WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (SELECT cast(substr(min(term_start),1,4) as int) FROM legislators_terms UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y< (SELECT cast(substr(max(term_end),1,4) as int) FROM legislators_terms)),r AS (SELECT *,row_number() over(partition by id_bioguide order by term_start,term_number,term_id) rn FROM legislators_terms),cohort AS (SELECT r.id_bioguide,r.term_start first_start FROM r JOIN legislators l USING(id_bioguide) WHERE rn=1 AND state='LA' AND gender='M'),active AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.id_bioguide,c.first_start,printf('%04d-12-31',y) snapshot,y-cast(substr(c.first_start,1,4) as int) period FROM cohort c JOIN legislators_terms t USING(id_bioguide) JOIN years ON printf('%04d-12-31',y) BETWEEN t.term_start AND t.term_end) SELECT period,count(distinct id_bioguide) legislators FROM active WHERE period BETWEEN 31 AND 49 GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

WITH RECURSIVE nums(k) AS (SELECT 31 UNION ALL SELECT k+1 FROM nums WHERE k<49),
ml AS (
  SELECT t.id_bioguide AS idb
  FROM legislators_terms t
  JOIN legislators l ON l.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
  WHERE t.state = 'LA' AND l.gender = 'M'
  GROUP BY t.id_bioguide
),
ft AS (
  SELECT t.id_bioguide AS idb, MIN(t.term_start) AS first_start
  FROM legislators_terms t
  JOIN ml ON ml.idb = t.id_bioguide
  GROUP BY t.id_bioguide
)
SELECT n.k AS years_since_first_term,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ft.idb) AS legislator_count
FROM ft JOIN nums n
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t2
  WHERE t2.id_bioguide = ft.idb
    AND t2.term_start <= (CAST(substr(ft.first_start,1,4) AS INT)+n.k)||'-12-31'
    AND t2.term_end   >= (CAST(substr(ft.first_start,1,4) AS INT)+n.k)||'-12-31'
)
GROUP BY n.k
ORDER BY n.k;
